description: This file contains the main activity class 'ActivityAnimations' for an Android application demonstrating custom activity transition animations. It manages an activity that displays a grid of photo thumbnails, applies grayscale filters, and handles thumbnail clicks to launch a detail activity with custom animations.

classes.name: ActivityAnimations
classes.description: Main activity class that displays a grid of photo thumbnails, applies grayscale filters, and handles user interaction to launch detailed views with custom animations.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the grid layout with photo thumbnails, and applies a grayscale filter to the images.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu for controlling animation speed settings.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections to modify animation scale settings.

methods.name: thumbnailClickListener
methods.description: Listener that responds to thumbnail clicks by collecting view info, creating an intent for the detail activity, and overriding default transitions to apply custom animations.
